description: Fixtures for data security scenario rubric with worked example (R34-T055)

scenarios.name: Customer PII Database
scenarios.asset: PostgreSQL database containing customer financial and PII records
scenarios.threat: Exfiltration of sensitive plaintext records during database backup
scenarios.control: Implement transparent database encryption (TDE) and encrypted backup exports
scenarios.residual_risk: Key compromise if master encryption keys are improperly stored

scenarios.name: Missing asset data scenario
scenarios.residual_risk: Man-in-the-middle if root CA certificates are untrusted

scenarios.name: Mismatched data protection control
scenarios.threat: Re-identification of anonymized patient health records
scenarios.control: Deploy storage volume snapshot replication to secondary region
scenarios.residual_risk: Replication copies anonymized data without mitigating re-identification risk
